words.meaning: a feeling of great happiness and triumph
words.sentence1: There was great jubilation across the farm after a successful harvest season. (There was great jubilation across the farm after a successful harvest season.)
words.sentence2: The festival was filled with songs of jubilation and shared feasts. (The festival was filled with songs of jubilation and shared feasts.)

words.sentence1: La cosecha abundante trajo mucho regocijo al pueblo. (The abundant harvest brought much rejoicing to the town.)
words.sentence2: Sus rostros reflejaban un profundo regocijo durante la celebración. (Their faces reflected deep joy during the celebration.)

words.sentence1: Les agriculteurs ont célébré la récolte dans l'allégresse. (The farmers celebrated the harvest with great joy.)
words.sentence2: Une douce allégresse se faisait sentir dans tout le village. (A sweet joy was felt throughout the entire village.)

words.meaning: joy or delight felt during or in celebration of the harvest
words.sentence1: Die Erntefreude war den Gesichtern der Dorfbewohner anzusehen. (The joy of the harvest could be seen on the faces of the villagers.)
words.sentence2: Mit großer Erntefreude brachten sie die letzten Früchte ein. (With great harvest joy, they brought in the last fruits.)

words.meaning: abundant harvest or a bountiful year for crops
words.sentence1: Murabito-tachi wa kotoshi no hōnen o iwatta. (The villagers celebrated this year's abundant harvest.)
words.sentence2: Hōnen o kinen shite matsuri ga okonawareta. (A festival was held to commemorate the bountiful harvest.)

words.sentence1: C'è stata grande esultanza per la fine della raccolta nei campi. (There was great exultation for the end of the harvest in the fields.)
words.sentence2: L'esultanza della folla riempiva la piazza di gioia. (The exultation of the crowd filled the square with joy.)

words.sentence1: Nongminmen zai tianye li qingzhu jintian de fengshou. (The farmers celebrated today's harvest in the fields.)
words.sentence2: Zhege jiji de fengshou dai lai le wuxian de xiyue. (The harvest of this season brought boundless joy.)

words.sentence1: Olhaeui pungsong-eul iueodeul-gwa hamkke chukhadang-haetda. (We celebrated this year's abundant harvest together with our neighbors.)
words.sentence2: Pungsong-ui gippeum-i deulpan-e gadeukhaetda. (The joy of the bountiful harvest filled the fields.)

words.sentence1: Prachearast rkthol borabor knong kar kromka chnamsne. (The people found abundance in this year's farming.)
words.sentence2: Tgnai nischea cholmouy kar richreay samrab borabor. (This day brings happiness for the abundant harvest.)

words.meaning: harvest joy, the happiness associated with gathering crops
words.sentence1: Die boere het die oesvreugde saam met hul gesinne gedeel. (The farmers shared the harvest joy with their families.)
words.sentence2: Oesvreugde was duidelik sigbaar tydens die feesmaaltyd. (Harvest joy was clearly visible during the feast.)
